description: A classic American traditional residential front yard photographed at standing eye-level in a centered composition at golden sunset. The home facade is natural cut limestone or cream quarry stone with a charcoal asphalt hipped roof and wide molded window surrounds in painted cream. A large multi-pane window with black steel frame and interior plantation shutters glowing warmly from inside occupies the center of the facade. Flanking the window, a formal symmetrical landscaped front garden bed contains two conical topiary boxwood pyramids trimmed to perfect cone shapes, with a large rounded globe topiary to the right. The garden bed is filled with blooming pink garden roses and white hydrangea clusters, adding romantic floral softness to the architectural formality. The lawn is manicured dark green grass. A flagstone or paver driveway in light grey stone curves from the lower right. To the far right, the home's grand arched entry portico is partially visible, warmly lit from within. The sky is a vivid sunset palette of warm amber, golden orange, and soft pink overhead. Warm amber light glows from the post-mounted lantern structure in the center of the garden, illuminating the landscaping below and contrasting beautifully with the peachy sunset sky. The palette is cream limestone, charcoal roof, vivid warm sunset, pink blooms, white blooms, deep green topiary, and warm amber.
